subject: computer-science
title: Algorithms & Flowcharts: Search & Sort
welcome_lead: Computers spend most of their time searching and sorting — let's see how.
meta_desc: KS3 algorithms: linear search, binary search, bubble sort intro.
final_note: Different algorithms suit different jobs — pick the right tool.

concepts.def: Checking items one by one from start to end.

walkthroughs.body_html: Linear search checks each item. Binary search needs a sorted list and halves the area each step — far faster on big lists.
Bubble sort compares neighbours and swaps if needed. After passes, the largest items 'bubble' to the end.
Tiny lists: linear search is fine. Big sorted data: binary search wins. Real apps use clever sorts like quicksort.
